title: Waymo's Robotaxis Took Over While Rivals Dropped Out
hook: Robotaxi rides just exploded 20-fold in barely a year and a half.
closing: The robotaxi race isn't close anymore. It's just Waymo.
question: Ride in a car with no driver?

segments.say: By February 2025, Waymo was giving 200,000 robotaxi rides every single week.
Waymo's robotaxi service spread fast: one city in 2020, now five, each one compounding the rides.
Waymo's biggest rival didn't make it -- its robotaxi business shut down for good in December 2024.
